Your Dedicated Manufacturing Partner for Precision CNC Milling

Core Milling Capabilities:

products.html:
We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in Ultra-High Precision Machining. This service is dedicated to projects where sub-micron tolerances, demanding surface finishes, and complex multi-axis geometries (such as impellers and advanced housings) are essential. We partner with leaders in Aerospace, Scientific Instrumentation, and High-End Robotics to solve the industry’s toughest design and manufacturing challenges.

Where Tolerance Meets Trust: Achieving the Unmachinable

In the realm of high-stakes product development, "Precision" is not a feature—it is the foundation. Our Precision Machining service is specifically tailored for clients whose components—like advanced turbomachinery or critical sensor enclosures (as pictured)—cannot afford dimensional variance. We specialize in components that others deem too complex or too difficult to hold tolerance on.

 

Key Pillars of Our Precision Commitment:

 

  • Mastery of Multi-Axis Machining: Our core strength lies in leveraging true 5-Axis continuous machining to produce parts with contoured surfaces, deep pockets, and complex internal features (such as the impeller blade geometry), often requiring a single setup to minimize error accumulation.

  • Tolerance Certification: We consistently hold and verify geometric and dimensional tolerances tighter than ±0.01mm (down to sub-micron levels), utilizing advanced metrology equipment and climate-controlled inspection areas to maintain accuracy.

  • Material Integrity: Specialized knowledge in machining high-performance alloys (e.g., Titanium, Inconel, hardened Stainless Steels) that are often required for lightweight, high-temperature, or high-pressure precision applications.

  • Surface Criticality: Dedicated finishing processes (lapping, polishing, specialized coatings) to achieve ultra-smooth Ra values required for optical, fluid dynamics, and critical sealing surfaces.

We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in the manufacturing of complex, multi-featured components through integrated CNC and 5-Axis machining. Conquering Complexity: Single-Setup Manufacturing for Multi-Sided Parts

Our Precision Machining Service is specifically designed for components like the one featured (the blue multi-sided part), which require high feature density and precise angular alignment across multiple faces. We view complexity not as an obstacle, but as a commitment to excellence.

 

Key Advantages for Multi-Sided Components:

 

  • Eliminating Tolerance Error: We specialize in utilizing advanced 5-Axis technology and custom fixturing to complete components with numerous bolt patterns, angled ports, and internal contours all in a single setup. This technique is crucial for eliminating tolerance chain errors that occur when a part is repeatedly reclamped.

  • High Feature Density: We excel at integrating multiple critical functions—such as fluid flow channels, sensor mounting points, and structural support—onto a single, consolidated component, which is vital for system miniaturization and performance.

  • Geometric Assurance: Our process focuses on optimizing tool paths and minimizing human intervention to ensure every dimension on your multi-sided part is delivered with verifiable, repeatable precision, regardless of the material used.

 

Your Reliable B2B Partnership:

 

We are the manufacturing partner you need when the part’s geometric complexity requires capabilities beyond standard 3-axis machining. We provide full ISO 9001 quality records, 6-month product warranty, and technical consultation from DFM (Design for Manufacturability) review onwards.

If your part's complexity demands a single-setup solution, contact us to bridge the gap between complex design and reliable production.

products.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in High-Precision CNC Turning Services for cylindrical, conical, and complex rotary components. Our capabilities include standard turning, advanced live tooling (mill-turn), and high-volume production of shafts, fittings, flanges, and bushings. We serve OEM clients requiring superior concentricity, surface finish, and threading accuracy for fluid dynamics, instruments, and motor applications.

Concentric Perfection: High-Precision CNC Turning Solutions

Our CNC Turning Service is dedicated to achieving the highest standards of precision for your rotational components. In critical applications, the performance of a shaft, bushing, or fitting depends entirely on its concentricity, roundness, and thread integrity. Our advanced turning centers are maintained for maximum rigidity and thermal stability, ensuring your components meet their precise functional requirements.

 

Core Turning Capabilities & Technical Assurance:

 

  • Process Focus: Dedicated CNC Lathes and Mill-Turn Centers (Live Tooling) for integrated turning and milling operations, allowing us to produce complex parts (like those with off-center holes or side slots) in a single, accurate setup.

  • Accuracy Metrics: Special emphasis on achieving extremely tight tolerances on diameters, lengths, and runout (concentricity). Superior control over surface finish (Ra values) for sealing and bearing surfaces.

  • Component Range: Specializing in small to medium-volume production of high-value parts, including: Hydraulic Fittings, Motor Shafts, Flanges, Custom Bolts, and Threaded Housings.

  • Material Expertise: Expert handling of stainless steels, aluminum, brass, copper, and engineering plastics used for rotational parts.

products.name: Custom Rotary & Cylindrical Components
products.description: As a key supplier of Precision CNC Turning Services, we excel in integrated Mill-Turn manufacturing. This capability eliminates the need for multiple setups, significantl
products.html:
As a key supplier of Precision CNC Turning Services, we excel in integrated Mill-Turn manufacturing. This capability eliminates the need for multiple setups, significantly boosting efficiency and part quality for complex rotary components, fittings, and housings. Certified ISO 9001, we provide reliable B2B supply for high-demand applications across various materials, including challenging alloys like brass and stainless steel.

Driving Efficiency: The Power of Integrated Mill-Turn Machining

In today's B2B landscape, time and reliability are paramount. Our CNC Turning Service is driven by Mill-Turn Technology, which is the intelligent convergence of turning and milling within a single machine tool. This process innovation is your direct path to improved component accuracy and compressed lead times, especially for parts requiring both cylindrical forms and off-axis features (like holes, flats, or slots).

Key Advantages of Mill-Turn Integration:

 

  • Minimized Handling, Maximized Accuracy: By performing multiple operations (turning, drilling, threading, milling) without removing the component from the chuck, we virtually eliminate alignment errors and boost concentricity compared to conventional two-step processing.

  • Complex Features on Rotary Parts: Ideal for manufacturing components that require threads, precise external/internal features, and cross-axis drilling, such as specialized hydraulic fittings, sensor bodies, and complex flange connections (as demonstrated in the image examples).

  • Material Versatility: Proven expertise in machining a wide array of materials, from standard Aluminum and Stainless Steel to high-value alloys like Brass and Copper, ensuring optimized tool life and surface finish for each material type.

Threaded Reliability: Precision Turning for Critical Fluid and Mechanical Connections

For applications involving fluid transfer, high pressure, or critical structural joining, the accuracy of fittings, connectors, and flanges is paramount. Our CNC Turning Service is specifically engineered to ensure thread integrity, exact bore sizing, and flawless sealing surfaces. The components shown (e.g., hose barbs, threaded adaptors, multi-holed flanges) are core examples of our rotational expertise.

 

Key Focus Areas for Connectors & Fittings:

 

  • Threading Excellence: We guarantee precise adherence to various international threading standards (e.g., NPT, BSPT, Metric) crucial for leak-proof performance in hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

  • Material Diversity: Extensive proficiency in turning a wide range of materials required for corrosion resistance and strength, including Brass, Copper, Stainless Steel (300/400 series), and Aluminum.

  • Integrated Secondary Features: We seamlessly execute secondary features on turned parts, such as cross-drilling, milling flats, hex features, and complex internal grooves using our live tooling (mill-turn) capabilities.

  • Surface Integrity: Specialized polishing and finishing techniques for sealing surfaces to ensure compatibility with gaskets and O-rings, meeting the high demands of laboratory analysis equipment and industrial valves.

In many applications, the final look and long-term durability of a milled component are just as critical as its dimensional accuracy. Our CNC Milling Service extends beyond the machine bed. We provide a full-service manufacturing pipeline that ensures material suitability and provides the necessary protective or aesthetic surface treatments your product demands.

 

Key Areas of Material and Finishing Excellence:

 

  • Material Versatility: We maintain specialized tooling and processes optimized for your desired metal:

    • Aluminum: Ideal for lightweight blocks and brackets (e.g., Anodizing, Chromate Conversion).

    • Stainless Steel: Crucial for corrosion-resistant housings (e.g., Passivation, Electropolishing).

    • Brass/Copper: Used for high-conductivity or specialized fittings (e.g., Plating, Polishing).

products.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in Extreme Precision Machining for highly critical applications in fluid dynamics, aerospace, and high-performance turbomachinery. Our expertise is proven in producing components with complex, non-orthogonal surfaces, such as impeller blades, intricate valve housings, and multi-featured rotational bodies. We mitigate geometric risk by utilizing advanced metrology and continuous 5-axis processing, ensuring compliance with the most stringent tolerance and performance requirements.

Beyond Limits: Guaranteed Performance for Complex Aerodynamic and Fluid Components

Our Precision Machining Service represents the apex of our technical capability. It is dedicated to manufacturing components like impeller blades and fluid management bodies where a fraction of a millimeter in tolerance directly impacts aerodynamic efficiency, flow dynamics, and system safety.

 

Key Focus on Impellers and Complex Curves:

 

  • 5-Axis Contouring Mastery: We utilize advanced continuous 5-Axis CNC Machining to precisely control the complex curved surfaces and airfoil geometry found in turbine blades and impellers, ensuring optimal performance characteristics (as shown in the featured component).

  • Geometric Integrity Verification: Precision is verified using sophisticated tools (like CMM—Coordinate Measuring Machines) to accurately map complex free-form surfaces against the 3D model, guaranteeing every point on the curve is within tolerance.

  • Complex Fluid Management: Expertise extends to components with internal and external features crucial for fluid control, such as angled fittings and multi-port valve bodies, where bore alignment and sealing faces are non-negotiable for pressure integrity.

  • Component Traceability: For high-reliability sectors, we provide full material certifications and maintain rigorous batch traceability, documenting the process from raw billet to final inspection.

products.html:
As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for the automotive aftermarket, we provide rapid prototyping and low-volume production for high-performance cooling systems. We fabricate custom Aluminum (6061/3003) Intercoolers, Radiators, and Intake Manifolds. Our facility integrates CNC Machining for precise end-tanks and ports with expert TIG Welding craftsmanship, delivering pressure-tested, track-ready components for tuning and racing applications.

Engineering Performance: From Concept to Track-Ready Prototype

In the competitive world of automotive tuning and racing, off-the-shelf parts often fail to meet specific performance goals. We position ourselves as your strategic Direct Manufacturer for custom fabrication and prototyping. We specialize in developing high-efficiency heat exchangers and structural intake components, transforming your CAD designs or rough samples into fully functional, high-performance hardware.

Core Fabrication & Machining Competencies:

  • Hybrid Manufacturing (CNC + Welding): Performance parts like the intercooler illustrated require a mix of technologies. We utilize CNC Machining to carve billet aluminum end-tanks and inlet/outlet ports for optimized airflow dynamics. These precision components are then joined to the high-density core using manual TIG Welding, ensuring a bond that withstands high boost pressures and vibration.

  • Expert TIG Welding & Craftsmanship: For exposed performance parts, weld quality is both a structural and aesthetic requirement. Our certified welders produce consistent "stacked-dime" weld beads that are not only visually stunning but also structurally sound. We guarantee leak-proof performance through rigorous pressure testing on every prototype.

  • Rapid Prototyping for Fitment Verification: We understand the urgency of race seasons and product launches. Our Rapid Prototyping Service allows you to validate fitment, mounting points, and piping clearance in the actual vehicle chassis before committing to tooling. We support MOQ=1 for development, helping you refine the design quickly.

  • Premium Surface Finishing: Aesthetics drive sales in the aftermarket. We offer show-quality finishes, including Mirror Polishing, Brushed Aluminum, or durable Powder Coating/Anodizing. We ensure that the prototype looks as good as it performs, ready for marketing photos or auto show displays.

products.name: Custom Billet Aluminum Engine Cover Manufacturer and Automotive Prototype Supplier
products.description: As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for the high-performance automotive aftermarket, we provide precision CNC machining services for custom billet aluminum components
products.html:
As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for the high-performance automotive aftermarket, we provide precision CNC machining services for custom billet aluminum components. We machine complex engine covers, valve covers, and decorative housings from solid 6061-T6 aluminum blocks. Our facility utilizes advanced 5-axis machining to create intricate 3D curved surfaces and premium tool-path textures, delivering showroom-quality prototypes and small-batch production for tuning brands.

The Art of Billet: High-End Automotive Customization

In the elite world of automotive tuning and restoration, Billet Aluminum components are the gold standard for both strength and aesthetics. We position ourselves as your premier Direct Manufacturer for these high-value custom parts. Unlike cast parts which can be porous and brittle, our "Billet" components are CNC machined from a single solid block of aerospace-grade aluminum, offering superior structural integrity and an unmistakable premium look.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • Complex 3D Surface Machining: The cover illustrated demonstrates our capability to machine complex, sweeping curves. We utilize 5-Axis CNC Machining to follow the organic contours of automotive designs perfectly. This allows us to produce seamless shapes that fit tight engine bays while maximizing visual impact.

  • Signature "Machine Finish" Aesthetics: For many tuning enthusiasts, the evidence of precision is in the tool path. We can program specific cutting strategies to leave a uniform, high-quality 3D ball-nose texture on the surface. This "raw machined" look captures the light beautifully and proves the part's billet origin. Of course, we also offer polishing, brushing, or anodizing if a smooth finish is preferred.

  • Rapid Prototyping for Fitment: Developing a custom engine cover requires perfect fitment over camshafts and sensors. Our Prototype Machining Service allows you to produce a single verification unit (MOQ=1) to test installation and hood clearance before committing to a larger run.

  • Material Excellence (6061-T6 / 7075): We strictly use high-grade aluminum alloys known for their excellent strength-to-weight ratio and anodizing quality. This ensures that the component not only looks good on a show car but can also withstand the high heat and vibration of a racing environment.

products.html:
As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for the automotive aftermarket, we provide engineering-grade prototyping services for high-performance induction systems. We fabricate custom aluminum intake manifolds, billet plenums, and turbo components designed to optimize volumetric efficiency. Leveraging advanced CNC machining and 3D modeling support, we deliver track-ready solutions that withstand high boost pressures for racing teams and tuning brands.

Engineering Horsepower: Precision Manufacturing for Airflow Systems

In the world of high-performance tuning, the intake manifold is the lungs of the engine. We position ourselves as your strategic Direct Manufacturer for custom induction components. We specialize in transforming complex 3D CAD designs into physical, high-performance hardware. Whether for a drift car, drag racer, or time-attack vehicle, we manufacture intake systems that maximize airflow and engine response.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • Billet Intake Manifold Fabrication: We excel in manufacturing multi-piece intake manifolds. Utilizing 5-Axis CNC Machining, we carve complex runner geometries and velocity stacks from solid 6061-T6 aluminum billets. This ensures perfectly smooth internal surfaces for laminar airflow, which cast parts often lack. Our precise flange machining guarantees a vacuum-tight seal against the cylinder head.

  • Turbo System Component Machining: High-boost applications require robust components. We manufacture custom turbo flanges, wastegate mounts, and intercooler piping connections that can withstand extreme heat and pressure cycles. Our machining capabilities ensure that all mating surfaces are perfectly flat to prevent exhaust or boost leaks.

  • Digital-to-Physical Prototyping: We are fully equipped to work with complex digital assemblies. We accept client STP/IGES files and perform DFM (Design for Manufacturing) analysis before cutting metal. This ensures that your custom plenum fits perfectly within the engine bay constraints and clears surrounding components like fuel rails and strut towers.

  • Aesthetic & Structural Excellence: Performance parts must look the part. We offer premium surface finishes, including raw machined billet, mirror polishing, or anodizing in custom colors. Structurally, our plenum designs are engineered and pressure-tested to ensure they can handle extreme boost levels without failure.

products.description: As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for automotive induction systems, we provide precision CNC machining services for electronic throttle bodies and intake control va
products.html:
As a specialized Manufacturing Supplier for automotive induction systems, we provide precision CNC machining services for electronic throttle bodies and intake control valves. We transform complex 3D CAD designs into functional 6061-T6 aluminum prototypes. Our facility excels at machining intricate electronic housings and high-flow bores with tight geometric tolerances, ensuring smooth butterfly valve operation and perfect sensor alignment for tuning applications.

Precision Manufacturing for Drive-by-Wire Systems

In the era of modern automotive tuning, the Electronic Throttle Body is a critical component that demands absolute mechanical precision. We position ourselves as your strategic Direct Manufacturer for these complex electromechanical housings. We specialize in "CAD-to-Part" manufacturing, taking your digital engineering files and machining robust billet aluminum housings that replace fragile stock plastic units, capable of withstanding high boost and vibration.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • Complex Housing Machining: Processing a throttle body requires handling multiple distinct features in one part. We utilize 5-Axis CNC Machining to carve the main airflow bore, the motor housing, and the gear drive chambers from a solid block. This ensures that the electronic cover fits perfectly sealed against the main body, protecting sensitive internal electronics from moisture and dirt.

  • Bore & Shaft Alignment: For a throttle plate to open and close smoothly without sticking, the shaft bore alignment must be perfect. We hold h6/H7 fit tolerances on bearing bores to ensure the butterfly valve shaft rotates freely but without air leaks, providing precise throttle response for high-performance engines.

  • Digital Prototyping Support: We bridge the gap between design and reality. Our engineering team works directly with your STP/IGES files to verify DFM (Design for Manufacturing). We can produce a single functional prototype (MOQ=1) for you to test motor fitment, gear meshing, and airflow characteristics on the flow bench before mass production.

  • Aesthetic & Thermal Performance: Beyond function, our billet aluminum bodies offer superior heat dissipation compared to stock parts. We provide premium surface finishes—including anodizing in brand colors or clear chemical conversion—making the throttle body a centerpiece in any custom engine bay.

  • Scalable Factory Production: We are designed to support your supply chain flexibility. Whether you need a rapid prototype for design validation (MOQ=1) or a high-volume monthly shipment of 50,000 units, our ISO 9001 certified workflow ensures consistent quality across every batch.

Precision Turning Solutions for Critical Stainless Steel Components

In the manufacturing of rotating assemblies and control hardware, CNC Turning is the foundation of precision. We position ourselves as your dedicated Direct Manufacturer for high-quality stainless steel turned parts. We specialize in producing components where cylindricity, concentricity, and thread quality are non-negotiable, providing robust solutions for fluid control, marine hardware, and industrial automation sectors.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • High-Precision CNC Turning: We excel in the production of complex cylindrical geometries. Our facility is equipped with advanced CNC Turning Centers capable of holding tight tolerances (±0.005mm) on diameters and bearing fits. For components like the control assembly shown, we ensure perfect alignment between the shaft, flange, and locking features, guaranteeing smooth mechanical operation.

  • Turn-Mill Compound Capability: Modern turning is rarely just about round parts. We utilize Live Tooling (Turn-Mill) technology to perform secondary operations—such as milling flats, drilling cross-holes, or engraving text—in a single setup. This "Done-in-One" approach eliminates re-fixturing errors, ensuring that milling features are perfectly positioned relative to the turned axis.

  • Expertise in Hard Metal Turning: Machining Stainless Steel (304/316L) presents challenges like work hardening and tool wear. Our engineering team applies optimized cutting strategies and premium tooling to ensure consistent dimensional stability and surface finish (Ra 0.4 – 0.8), even on large production runs.

  • Premium Surface & Thread Quality: For exposed components, aesthetics matter. We pay meticulous attention to surface quality, offering finishes from fine turned textures to mirror polishing. Our automated threading cycles produce clean, burr-free threads that pass strict gauging requirements, ensuring easy assembly and reliable sealing.

articles.title: Custom CNC Machined Components for Prototypes and Production
articles.description: High precision CNC machined parts with 0.01–0.02 mm tolerances, clean finishing and stable multi batch quality for global prototypes and production orders.
articles.html:
High Precision CNC Machined Parts That Stay Consistent, Batch After Batch

High precision CNC machined parts are the mechanical foundation of many modern products. They sit inside assemblies, frames, housings and motion systems, quietly controlling alignment, preload, sealing and heat flow. A small deviation in one part can affect the performance of an entire system. For this reason, the real value of a CNC part lies in its accuracy, surface quality, stability from batch to batch and the ability to match the designer’s intent without compromise.

LZZ focuses on this type of part: custom CNC machined components produced to tight tolerances, clean surfaces and repeatable quality, for both prototypes and ongoing production.

Precision as a Product Feature

For many designs, dimensional accuracy is not just a drawing requirement but a key performance feature. LZZ parts are typically machined to tolerances around zero point zero one to zero point zero two millimeter on critical features when the material and geometry allow it. This level of control supports:

  • Reliable fits for shafts, bearings and bushings

  • Stable alignment between mating parts

  • Predictable assembly forces and torque values

Tight tolerance control is maintained on both milled and turned features, whether the part is produced on three axis, four axis, five axis machining centers or CNC lathes. The result is a part that behaves as the designer expects, without unexpected play or interference.

Surface, Edges and Finishing

The function of a CNC part is strongly influenced by surfaces and edges. LZZ products place emphasis on:

  • Clean machined surfaces that support sealing, sliding and mounting

  • Controlled edge conditions to avoid burrs that can damage seals or cables

  • Uniform anodizing on aluminum parts for both protection and appearance

This combination makes the parts suitable for visible assemblies as well as internal mechanisms. Consistent finishing across batches also simplifies downstream assembly and quality inspections on the customer side.

From Single Prototype to Repeatable Production

Many projects start with a handful of parts and then move into repeated orders. LZZ products are designed and processed with this transition in mind:

  • Prototype quantities between one and fifty pieces can typically be supplied within seven to fourteen days depending on part complexity.

  • The same process logic is then extended to multi batch production, keeping drawing, tooling and inspection methods stable.

  • Monthly output capacity above one hundred thousand pieces allows the same design to scale without changing supplier or process.

This approach ensures that the first sample, the tenth batch and the hundredth batch behave as the same product, not as slightly different variations of an idea.

Material and Geometry Flexibility

High precision CNC parts from LZZ are not locked to a single material or simple shape. The product scope covers:

  • Aluminum parts requiring low weight and clean anodized surfaces

  • Stainless steel components for high strength, wear resistance and corrosion resistance

  • Copper and brass parts where conductivity or thermal behavior is important

  • Machined plastic parts for insulation, weight reduction and functional housings

Complex three dimensional geometries, deep pockets, multi face features and combined milling and turning operations are supported by the mix of machining centers and turning equipment. This allows designers to treat the machined part as a fully functional element of their product, rather than a limitation.

Reverse Engineering and Customization

In many real situations, the “product” is not just a drawing but also an existing sample that already works. LZZ supports:

  • Reverse engineering from samples when formal drawings are missing or outdated

  • Adjustments to dimensions or features based on new functional requirements

  • Custom markings, color schemes and packaging to align parts with a brand or system architecture

This makes the CNC part line suitable for equipment upgrades, replacement parts and derivatives of existing designs, as well as completely new projects.

Logistics Built Into the Product Offering

For global buyers, a CNC part is not complete until it arrives without damage and on time. LZZ products are therefore supplied as part of a full delivery package that includes:

  • Protective internal packaging to avoid scratches and impact

  • Cartons or wooden cases sized to the shipment

  • Flexible shipping terms such as EXW, FOB or DDP to match different supply chain strategies

Minimum order quantity is one piece, and OEM or ODM arrangements are supported. This allows the same part specification to be used across development, pilot and mass production phases without structural changes to the supply model.

Turning Drawings Into Reliable CNC Products

High precision CNC machined parts from LZZ are designed to turn drawings and samples into consistent, repeatable products. Tight tolerances, clean surfaces and controlled processes keep every critical feature within spec, whether the order is for a single prototype or a repeated batch. Combined with flexible material options, reverse engineering capability and export-ready packaging, these CNC parts fit smoothly into global supply chains and complex assemblies. For designers and buyers, each finished component becomes a stable, predictable element in the overall product, rather than a variable that needs constant attention.
